Case :- Writ Tax No. - 1024 of 2025
Petitioner :- Vimla Devi

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Deshraj Garg Counsel for Respondent :- Nimai Dass, A.C.S.C.
Hon'ble Arun Bhansali,Chief Justice Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.
This petition has been filed by the petitioner seeking a direction to the respondents to refund the amount of TDS, which was deducted from the compensation paid to the petitioner.
2. Submissions have been made that land of the petitioner was acquired for National Highways and compensation was paid to the petitioner.
From the compensation, a sum of Rs. 1,01,761/- has been deducted as TDS and Form No. 16A has been issued to the petitioner.

Submissions have been made that the petitioner has moved an application to the Land Acquisition Officer for refund of the said amount and, therefore, the authority may be directed to decide the said representation.

3. A perusal of the record indicates that the amount deducted as TDS has already been deposited by the Land Acquisition Officer, which is evident from Form No. 16A (Annexure-5), wherein the PAN number of the petitioner is also reflected.

sentences.text:
In view of the fact that amount already stands deposited with the Income Tax Department, the refund can only be given in terms of the provisions of the Income Tax Act, wherein petitioner is required to file her return and seek refund of the excess amount deducted/deposited.
5.

In that view of the matter, the relief claimed in the petition for refund of TDS from respondents and seeking disposal of the writ petition would not come to the aid of the petitioner qua seeking the material relief of getting the refund.
6. In that view of the matter, the petition stands disposed of.
7. The petitioner may take action in accordance with the provisions of the Income Tax Act for seeking refund of the amount of TDS deposited by the competent authority/Land Acquisition Officer.
